named-query.name: Contact.findByTerm
named-query.query: select c from Contact c where lower(c.surname) like lower(concat('%', :term, '%')) or lower(c.name) like lower(concat('%', :term, '%')) or lower(c.phone) like lower(concat('%', :term, '%')) order by c.id

named-query.name: Contact.findByUserIdAndTerm
named-query.query: select c from Contact c where c.user.id = :userId and ( lower(c.surname) like lower(concat('%', :term, '%')) or lower(c.name) like lower(concat('%', :term, '%')) or lower(c.phone) like lower(concat('%', :term, '%')) ) order by c.id

named-query.name: Contact.deleteContactById
named-query.query: delete from Contact c where c.id = :contactId

named-query.name: Contact.deleteContactsByIds
named-query.query: delete from Contact c where c.id in :ids

named-query.name: Contact.deleteByIdAndUserId
named-query.query: delete from Contact c where c.id = :contactId and c.user.id = :userId

named-query.name: Contact.deleteAllByIdAndUserId
named-query.query: delete from Contact c where c.id in :ids and c.user.id = :userId
